bullets.title: Claude Code v2.1.319: denyInsteadOfPrompting, background MCP tasks, security fixes
bullets.summary: Per a DevelopersIO write-up (2026-11-08), v2.1.319 adds permissions.denyInsteadOfPrompting (denied instead of waiting on a prompt, incl. subagents), runs task-based MCP calls in the background, and fixes a Bash permission bypass, sed running unchecked in accept-edits/auto modes, and a worktree sandbox escape.
bullets.how: The Construct: enable denyInsteadOfPrompting for unattended scheduled agents so they never hang on a prompt; update to pick up the security fixes. PRAGMA: add to client Claude Code hardening checklist. Brand 9 Signs: no.

bullets.title: Claude Code 2.1.318/2.1.319 behavior changes: auto mode behind gateways, /loop, Chrome shortcuts removed
bullets.summary: Same write-up: auto mode now asks/denies when server-side checks are unavailable (opt back in with CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_MODE_SERVER=0), self-paced /loop ends if a turn doesn't reschedule (CLAUDE_CODE_LOOP_KEEPALIVE=1 restores old behavior), and Claude in Chrome shortcuts_list/shortcuts_execute tools were removed.
bullets.how: The Construct: audit any loops or Chrome-automation skills that relied on shortcuts_* or on self-paced /loop continuing. PRAGMA: breaking-change note for client automations. Brand 9 Signs: no.

bullets.title: Nov 10 AI digests (The Neuron, Agile Brand Guide, Agent Tools Today)
bullets.summary: Search surfaced same-day digests covering AI news, marketing-tech and agent/MCP launches, but the pages could not be read (fetch blocked), so no individual item is verified.
bullets.how: The Construct: manually skim for new MCP servers (video/CRM/DAM). PRAGMA: client briefing source. Brand 9 Signs: marketing-tech digest may have signage-relevant tools.

praxis_lesson: Version bumps in your agent runtime are operational news: read the breaking-change lines (permissions, loop, tool removals) before the next unattended run, not after it fails.
